learning.learning_goal: Connect number names, numerals, and quantities from 7 to 8.
learning.big_idea: A number tells how many dots there are.
novice_success_criteria: Recognize a number name and count a new arrangement.

screens.title: Meet 7–8.
screens.audio: Listen to the numbers. Count the dots. Then try it yourself.

screens.label: Number 7
screens.title: 7 — seven
screens.audio: This is seven. Seven dots. Tap the dots in order from one through seven.

screens.title: How many dots?
screens.audio: Count the dots. Choose the matching number.

visual.ariaLabel: Seven blue dots inside one box.

choices.feedback: Check that you did not count one dot twice.
Look for a dot you may have missed. Count each dot once.

hints: Start on the left. Point to each dot once.
Count again from one through seven.

screens.label: Make a group
screens.title: Make 7 dots.
screens.audio: Make a new group of seven dots. Tap Add a dot to put dots in the box. Check your group when you are ready.
screens.wrongFeedback: Count the dots in your box. Add or remove a dot, then check again.
screens.tooManyFeedback: There are more than seven dots. Remove one, then count again.
screens.tooFewFeedback: There are fewer than seven dots. Add one, then count again.
hints: Point to every dot once. Say its number as you point.
Keep adding or removing until your count ends at seven.

screens.label: Number 8
screens.title: 8 — eight
screens.audio: This is eight. Eight dots. Tap the dots in order from one through eight.

screens.title: How many dots?
screens.audio: Count the dots. Choose the matching number.

visual.ariaLabel: Eight blue dots inside one box.

choices.feedback: Look for a dot you may have missed. Count each dot once.
Check that you did not count one dot twice.

hints: Start on the left. Point to each dot once.
Count again from one through eight.

screens.label: Your turn
screens.title: Make 8 dots.
screens.audio: Make eight dots. Count as you add them. Then check.
screens.wrongFeedback: Count your dots and try again.
screens.tooManyFeedback: There are more than eight dots. Remove one, then count again.
screens.tooFewFeedback: There are fewer than eight dots. Add one, then count again.
hints: Touch and count each dot in your box.
Count from one to eight. Stop at eight.

screens.title: How many dots?
screens.audio: Count the dots. Tap the number that shows how many dots there are.

choices.feedback: Count every dot once. Check for a dot you missed or counted twice.
Count every dot once. Check for a dot you missed or counted twice.

hints: Start at the left. Touch each dot as you count.
Count each dot once. Then tap the number you reached.

screens.title: How many dots?
screens.audio: Count the dots. Tap the number that shows how many dots there are.

choices.feedback: Count every dot once. Check for a dot you missed or counted twice.
Count every dot once. Check for a dot you missed or counted twice.

hints: Start at the left. Touch each dot as you count.
Count each dot once. Then tap the number you reached.

screens.title: Listen. Find the number.
hints: Tap Listen to hear the number again.

screens.title: You finished this part.
screens.body: You can take a break. Come back to practice again.
screens.audio: You finished this part. You can take a break. Come back to practice again.
